quarterly_data.signal: The EU approval of Sarclisa subcutaneous (June 8, 2026, across all Sarclisa IV indications) rests on the pivotal IRAKLIA phase 3 study in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma: Sarclisa SC via on-body injector plus pomalidomide-dexamethasone achieved a 71.1% objective response rate vs 70.5% for Sarclisa IV-Pd, establishing non-inferiority (risk ratio 1.008; 95% CI 0.903-1.126; p=0.0006); systemic infusion reactions occurred in 1.5% of SC patients vs 25% on IV, and injection-site reactions in 19/5,145 OBI injections. In IRAKLIA 70% of OBI patients were satisfied or very satisfied vs 53.4% on IV (OR 2.036; p=0.0001), and in the IZALCO phase 2 study 74.5% preferred the OBI over manual injection (17% preferred manual). Median injection time was 13 minutes in clinic and at home. The device is Enable Injections' CirCLIQ on-body injector (enFuse platform). Sarclisa is approved in almost 60 countries and has been prescribed to nearly 70,000 patients; SC submissions are under review in the US, China and Japan.
